title: Payer-Covered Reserved Days: Counting Against the Limits
content:
Under **Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations**, payer-covered reserved days are counted across reservations: Medicaid hospital reserved days count per hospitalization, consecutively from the departure date, up to the per-hospitalization limit; Medicaid therapeutic leave days count across every therapeutic reservation of the resident in the calendar year, up to the per-calendar-year limit. A day is booked as payer-reserved only while the applicable limit still has room; every later held day of the leave is resident-private and is held only under a private extension. Medicare Part A never pays a held day.

### What is counted

- **Per hospitalization:** the payer-reserved days booked on the reservation for the one hospitalization it covers, from the departure date, less any of those days later reversed.
- **Per calendar year:** the payer-reserved days booked across all of the resident's therapeutic leave reservations in the calendar year of the held day, less any of those days later reversed.

The limits themselves are the tier's reserved days per hospitalization and therapeutic leave days per calendar year as the coverage schedule of the tier states them.

### Room left on the limits

The payer days still available are the per-hospitalization limit less the per-hospitalization count, never below zero, added to the per-calendar-year limit less the per-calendar-year count, never below zero. While that figure is above zero, the next held day is booked payer-reserved; once it is zero, the held day is resident-private.

### Worked figures (hypothetical day counts)

| Limit | Days already counted | Room left | Next held day |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15 per hospitalization (Medicaid Hospital Leave Reserved Bed) | 10 | 5 | payer-reserved |
| 15 per hospitalization (Medicaid Hospital Leave Reserved Bed) | 15 | 0 | resident-private |
| 30 per calendar year (Medicaid Therapeutic Leave Reserved Bed) | 34 booked, 6 reversed (28 counted) | 2 | payer-reserved |

**Points of judgement.** A reversed payer-reserved day no longer counts against the limit. Therapeutic days of different reservations in the same calendar year count together. On a Medicare skilled stay no held day is ever booked as payer-paid by Part A.
